abstract.t: On page 5 of RFC 107, at the end of the section titled 'V. Flow Control', the partial sentence:
abstract.artwork: Each of these numbers is interpreted as "the number of 128ths of the current allocation" to be returned if it is in the range zero to 128...
...if it is the range of zero to 127,... ---
abstract.t: That is, return al the appropriate allocation if and only if the high-order of the left-most bit of the corresponding fraction is 1.
